verses.original: וְאַתָּ֤ה בֶן־ אָדָם֙ קַח־ לְךָ֣ לְבֵנָ֔ה וְנָתַתָּ֥ה אוֹתָ֖הּ לְפָנֶ֑יךָ וְחַקּוֹתָ֥ עָלֶ֛יהָ עִ֖יר אֶת־ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ḇen- ’ā·ḏām qaḥ- lə·ḵā lə·ḇê·nāh wə·nā·ṯat·tāh ’ō·w·ṯāh lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā wə·ḥaq·qō·w·ṯā ‘ā·le·hā ‘îr ’eṯ- yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Now you son of man take a brick place it before you and draw on it the city of Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: TU, pois, ó filho do homem, toma um tijolo, e pô-lo-ás diante de ti, e grava nele a cidade de Jerusalém.

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֨ה עָלֶ֜יהָ מָצ֗וֹר וּבָנִ֤יתָ עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ דָּיֵ֔ק וְשָׁפַכְתָּ֥ עָלֶ֖יהָ סֹֽלְלָ֑ה וְנָתַתָּ֨ה עָלֶ֧יהָ מַחֲנ֛וֹת וְשִׂים־ עָלֶ֥יהָ כָּרִ֖ים סָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tāh ‘ā·le·hā mā·ṣō·wr ū·ḇā·nî·ṯā ‘ā·le·hā dā·yêq wə·šā·p̄aḵ·tā ‘ā·le·hā sō·lə·lāh wə·nā·ṯat·tāh ‘ā·le·hā ma·ḥă·nō·wṯ wə·śîm- ‘ā·le·hā kā·rîm sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: Then lay siege against it Construct a siege wall build a ramp to it set up camps against it and place battering rams around it on all sides
verses.literalPt: E põe contra ela um cerco, e edifica contra ela uma fortificação, e levanta contra ela uma trincheira, e põe contra ela arraiais, e põe-lhe aríetes em redor.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֤ה קַח־ לְךָ֙ מַחֲבַ֣ת בַּרְזֶ֔ל וְנָתַתָּ֤ה אוֹתָהּ֙ קִ֣יר בַּרְזֶ֔ל בֵּינְךָ֖ וּבֵ֣ין הָעִ֑יר וַהֲכִינֹתָה֩ אֶת־ פָּנֶ֨יךָ אֵלֶ֜יהָ וְהָיְתָ֤ה בַמָּצוֹר֙ וְצַרְתָּ֣ עָלֶ֔יהָ א֥וֹת הִ֖יא לְבֵ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh qaḥ- lə·ḵā ma·ḥă·ḇaṯ bar·zel wə·nā·ṯat·tāh ’ō·w·ṯāh qîr bar·zel bê·nə·ḵā ū·ḇên hā·‘îr wa·hă·ḵî·nō·ṯāh ’eṯ- pā·ne·ḵā ’ê·le·hā wə·hā·yə·ṯāh ḇam·mā·ṣō·wr wə·ṣar·tā ‘ā·le·hā ’ō·wṯ hî lə·ḇêṯ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Then take an iron plate and set it up as an iron wall between yourself . . . and the city Turn your face toward it so that it is under siege and besiege it . . . This will be a sign to the house of Israel
verses.literalPt: E tu toma uma sertã de ferro, e põe-na por muro de ferro entre ti e a cidade; e dirige para ela o teu rosto, e assim será cercada, e a cercarás; isto servirá de sinal à casa de Israel.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֤ה שְׁכַב֙ עַל־ צִדְּךָ֣ הַשְּׂמָאלִ֔י וְשַׂמְתָּ֛ אֶת־ עֲוֺ֥ן בֵּֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עָלָ֑יו מִסְפַּ֤ר הַיָּמִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּשְׁכַּ֣ב עָלָ֔יו תִּשָּׂ֖א אֶת־ עֲוֺנָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh šə·ḵaḇ ‘al- ṣid·də·ḵā haś·śə·mā·lî wə·śam·tā ’eṯ- ‘ă·wōn bêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl ‘ā·lāw mis·par hay·yā·mîm ’ă·šer tiš·kaḇ ‘ā·lāw tiś·śā ’eṯ- ‘ă·wō·nām
verses.literal: Then lie down on your left side and place the iniquity of the house of Israel upon yourself You are to bear their iniquity for the number of days you lie on your side . . .
verses.literalPt: Tu também deita-te sobre o teu lado esquerdo, e põe a iniqüidade da casa de Israel sobre ele; conforme o número dos dias que te deitares sobre ele, levarás as suas iniqüidades.

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֗י נָתַ֤תִּֽי לְךָ֙ אֶת־ שְׁנֵ֣י עֲוֺנָ֔ם לְמִסְפַּ֣ר יָמִ֔ים שְׁלֹשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת וְתִשְׁעִ֖ים י֑וֹם וְנָשָׂ֖אתָ עֲוֺ֥ן בֵּֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî nā·ṯat·tî lə·ḵā ’eṯ- šə·nê ‘ă·wō·nām lə·mis·par yā·mîm šə·lōš- mê·’ō·wṯ wə·ṯiš·‘îm yō·wm wə·nā·śā·ṯā ‘ă·wōn bêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: For I have assigned to you 390 . . . . . . days according to the number of years of their iniquity So you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Israel
verses.literalPt: Porque eu já te tenho fixado os anos da sua iniqüidade, conforme o número dos dias, trezentos e noventa dias; e levarás a iniqüidade da casa de Israel.

verses.original: וְכִלִּיתָ֣ אֶת־ אֵ֗לֶּה וְשָׁ֨כַבְתָּ֜ עַל־ צִדְּךָ֤ הַיְמוֹנִי שֵׁנִ֔ית וְנָשָׂ֖אתָ אֶת־ עֲוֺ֣ן בֵּית־ יְהוּדָ֑ה אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֔וֹם י֧וֹם לַשָּׁנָ֛ה י֥וֹם לַשָּׁנָ֖ה נְתַתִּ֥יו לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵil·lî·ṯā ’eṯ- ’êl·leh wə·šā·ḵaḇ·tā ‘al- ṣid·də·ḵā hay·mō·nī šê·nîṯ wə·nā·śā·ṯā ’eṯ- ‘ă·wōn bêṯ- yə·hū·ḏāh ’ar·bā·‘îm yō·wm yō·wm laš·šā·nāh yō·wm laš·šā·nāh nə·ṯat·tîw lāḵ
verses.literal: When you have completed these days lie down again but on your right side and bear the iniquity of the house of Judah I have assigned to you 40 days a day . . . for each year . . .
verses.literalPt: E, quando tiveres cumprido estes dias, tornar-te-ás a deitar sobre o teu lado direito, e levarás a iniqüidade da casa de Judá quarenta dias; um dia te dei para cada ano.

verses.original: וְאֶל־ מְצ֤וֹר יְרוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ תָּכִ֣ין פָּנֶ֔יךָ וּֽזְרֹעֲךָ֖ חֲשׂוּפָ֑ה וְנִבֵּאתָ֖ עָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’el- mə·ṣō·wr yə·rū·šā·lim tā·ḵîn pā·ne·ḵā ū·zə·rō·‘ă·ḵā ḥă·śū·p̄āh wə·nib·bê·ṯā ‘ā·le·hā
verses.literal: You must turn your face toward the siege of Jerusalem with your arm bared and prophesy against it
verses.literalPt: Dirigirás, pois, o teu rosto para o cerco de Jerusalém, com o teu braço descoberto, e profetizarás contra ela.

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֛ה נָתַ֥תִּי עָלֶ֖יךָ עֲבוֹתִ֑ים וְלֹֽא־ תֵהָפֵ֤ךְ מִֽצִּדְּךָ֙ אֶל־ צִדֶּ֔ךָ עַד־ כַּלּוֹתְךָ֖ יְמֵ֥י מְצוּרֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh nā·ṯat·tî ‘ā·le·ḵā ‘ă·ḇō·w·ṯîm wə·lō- ṯê·hā·p̄êḵ miṣ·ṣid·də·ḵā ’el- ṣid·de·ḵā ‘aḏ- kal·lō·wṯ·ḵā yə·mê mə·ṣū·re·ḵā
verses.literal: Now behold I will tie you up with ropes . . . so you cannot turn from side to side until you have finished the days of your siege
verses.literalPt: E eis que porei sobre ti cordas; assim tu não te voltarás de um lado para o outro, até que cumpras os dias do teu cerco.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה קַח־ לְךָ֡ חִטִּ֡ין וּ֠שְׂעֹרִים וּפ֨וֹל וַעֲדָשִׁ֜ים וְדֹ֣חַן וְכֻסְּמִ֗ים וְנָתַתָּ֤ה אוֹתָם֙ בִּכְלִ֣י אֶחָ֔ד וְעָשִׂ֧יתָ אוֹתָ֛ם לְךָ֖ לְלָ֑חֶם מִסְפַּ֨ר הַיָּמִ֜ים אֲשֶׁר־ אַתָּ֣ה׀ שׁוֹכֵ֣ב עַֽל־ צִדְּךָ֗ שְׁלֹשׁ־ מֵא֧וֹת וְתִשְׁעִ֛ים י֖וֹם תֹּאכֲלֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh qaḥ- lə·ḵā ḥiṭ·ṭîn ū·śə·‘ō·rîm ū·p̄ō·wl wa·‘ă·ḏā·šîm wə·ḏō·ḥan wə·ḵus·sə·mîm wə·nā·ṯat·tāh ’ō·w·ṯām biḵ·lî ’e·ḥāḏ wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ’ō·w·ṯām lə·ḵā lə·lā·ḥem mis·par hay·yā·mîm ’ă·šer- ’at·tāh šō·w·ḵêḇ ‘al- ṣid·də·ḵā šə·lōš- mê·’ō·wṯ wə·ṯiš·‘îm yō·wm tō·ḵă·len·nū
verses.literal: But take wheat barley beans lentils millet and spelt put them in a single container and make them into bread for yourself This is what you are to eat during the 390 . . . . . . days . . . you lie on your side
verses.literalPt: E tu, toma trigo, e cevada, e favas, e lentilhas, e milho e aveia, e coloca-os numa vasilha, e faze deles pão; conforme o número dos dias que tu te deitares sobre o teu lado, trezentos e noventa dias, comerás disso.

verses.original: וּמַאֲכָֽלְךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֹּאכֲלֶ֔נּוּ בְּמִשְׁק֕וֹל עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שֶׁ֖קֶל לַיּ֑וֹם מֵעֵ֥ת עַד־ עֵ֖ת תֹּאכֲלֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ma·’ă·ḵā·lə·ḵā ’ă·šer tō·ḵă·len·nū bə·miš·qō·wl ‘eś·rîm še·qel lay·yō·wm mê·‘êṯ ‘aḏ- ‘êṯ tō·ḵă·len·nū
verses.literal: You are to weigh out twenty shekels of food to eat each day and you are to eat it at set times . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: E a tua comida, que hás de comer, será do peso de vinte siclos por dia; de tempo em tempo a comerás.

verses.original: וּמַ֛יִם בִּמְשׂוּרָ֥ה תִשְׁתֶּ֖ה שִׁשִּׁ֣ית הַהִ֑ין מֵעֵ֥ת עַד־ עֵ֖ת תִּשְׁתֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ma·yim bim·śū·rāh ṯiš·teh šiš·šîṯ ha·hîn mê·‘êṯ ‘aḏ- ‘êṯ tiš·teh
verses.literal: You are also to measure out a sixth of a hin of water to drink and you are to drink it at set times . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Também beberás a água por medida, a saber, a sexta parte de um him; de tempo em tempo beberás.

verses.original: וְעֻגַ֥ת שְׂעֹרִ֖ים תֹּֽאכֲלֶ֑נָּה וְהִ֗יא בְּגֶֽלְלֵי֙ צֵאַ֣ת הָֽאָדָ֔ם תְּעֻגֶ֖נָה לְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘u·ḡaṯ śə·‘ō·rîm tō·ḵă·len·nāh wə·hî bə·ḡel·lê ṣê·’aṯ hā·’ā·ḏām tə·‘u·ḡe·nāh lə·‘ê·nê·hem
verses.literal: And you shall eat the food as you would a barley cake after you bake it over dried human excrement . . . in the sight of the people
verses.literalPt: E o que comeres será como bolos de cevada, e cozê-los-ás sobre o esterco que sai do homem, diante dos olhos deles.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֔ה כָּ֣כָה יֹאכְל֧וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת־ לַחְמָ֖ם טָמֵ֑א בַּגּוֹיִ֕ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַדִּיחֵ֖ם שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh kā·ḵāh yō·ḵə·lū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- laḥ·mām ṭā·mê bag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer ’ad·dî·ḥêm šām
verses.literal: Then the LORD said This is how the Israelites . . . will eat their defiled bread among the nations to which I will banish them . . .
verses.literalPt: E disse o SENHOR: Assim comerão os filhos de Israel o seu pão imundo, entre os gentios para onde os lançarei.

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֗ר אֲהָהּ֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה הִנֵּ֥ה נַפְשִׁ֖י לֹ֣א מְטֻמָּאָ֑ה וּנְבֵלָ֨ה וּטְרֵפָ֤ה לֹֽא־ אָכַ֙לְתִּי֙ מִנְּעוּרַ֣י וְעַד־ עַ֔תָּה וְלֹא־ בָ֥א בְּפִ֖י בְּשַׂ֥ר פִּגּֽוּל׃ס
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar ’ă·hāh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hin·nêh nap̄·šî lō mə·ṭum·mā·’āh ū·nə·ḇê·lāh ū·ṭə·rê·p̄āh lō- ’ā·ḵal·tî min·nə·‘ū·ray wə·‘aḏ- ‘at·tāh wə·lō- ḇā bə·p̄î bə·śar pig·gūl
verses.literal: Ah Lord GOD I said . . . I have never defiled myself From my youth until now I have not eaten anything found dead or mauled by wild beasts No unclean meat has ever entered my mouth
verses.literalPt: Então disse eu: Ah! Senhor DEUS! Eis que a minha alma não foi contaminada, pois desde a minha mocidade até agora, nunca comi daquilo que morrer de si mesmo, ou que é despedaçado por feras; nem carne abominável entrou na minha boca.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י רְאֵ֗ה נָתַ֤תִּֽי לְךָ֙ אֶת־ צְפוּעֵי הַבָּקָ֔ר תַּ֖חַת גֶּלְלֵ֣י הָֽאָדָ֑ם וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ אֶֽת־ לַחְמְךָ֖ עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lay rə·’êh nā·ṯat·tî lə·ḵā ’eṯ- ṣə·p̄ū·ʿē hab·bā·qār ta·ḥaṯ gel·lê hā·’ā·ḏām wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ’eṯ- laḥ·mə·ḵā ‘ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: Look He replied . . . I will let you use cow dung instead of human excrement and you may bake your bread over that
verses.literalPt: E disse-me: Vê, dei-te esterco de vacas, em lugar de esterco de homem; e sobre ele prepararás o teu pão.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י בֶּן־ אָדָם֙ הִנְנִ֨י שֹׁבֵ֤ר מַטֵּה־ לֶ֙חֶם֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְאָכְלוּ־ לֶ֥חֶם בְּמִשְׁקָ֖ל וּבִדְאָגָ֑ה וּמַ֕יִם בִּמְשׂוּרָ֥ה וּבְשִׁמָּמ֖וֹן יִשְׁתּֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lay ben- ’ā·ḏām hin·nî šō·ḇêr maṭ·ṭêh- le·ḥem bî·rū·šā·lim wə·’ā·ḵə·lū- le·ḥem bə·miš·qāl ū·ḇiḏ·’ā·ḡāh ū·ma·yim bim·śū·rāh ū·ḇə·šim·mā·mō·wn yiš·tū
verses.literal: Then He told me Son of man . . . I am going to cut off the supply of food in Jerusalem They will anxiously eat bread rationed by weight and in despair they will drink water by measure
verses.literalPt: Disse-me ainda: Filho do homem, eis que eu quebrarei o sustento de pão em Jerusalém, e comerão o pão por peso, e com ansiedade; e a água beberão por medida, e com espanto;

verses.original: לְמַ֥עַן יַחְסְר֖וּ לֶ֣חֶם וָמָ֑יִם וְנָשַׁ֙מּוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ וְאָחִ֔יו וְנָמַ֖קּוּ בַּעֲוֺנָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an yaḥ·sə·rū le·ḥem wā·mā·yim wə·nā·šam·mū ’îš wə·’ā·ḥîw wə·nā·maq·qū ba·‘ă·wō·nām
verses.literal: So they will lack food and water they will be appalled at the sight of one another wasting away in their iniquity
verses.literalPt: Para que lhes falte o pão e a água, e se espantem uns com os outros, e se consumam nas suas iniqüidades.
